title: Wars of the Roses
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Wars of the Roses", at revision 1375993311, opens: "The Wars of the Roses, known at the time and in the following centuries as the Civil Wars, were a series of armed confrontations, machinations, battles and campaigns fought for control of the English throne from 1455 to 1487. The conflict was fought between supporters of the House of York and the House of Lancaster, two rival cadet branches of the royal House of Plantagenet. The conflict resulted in the end of Lancaster's male line in 1471, leaving the Tudor family to inherit, through the female line, the Lancaster claim to the throne. The conflict was largely brought to an end upon the union of the two houses through marriage, creating the Tudor dynasty that would subsequently rule England." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q127751, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "dynastic civil war in England from 1455 to 1487". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
